title: Communities are waiting on billions in disaster funding from the Trump administration
summary: States say disaster funding from the Federal Emergency Management Agency has slowed to a trickle under the Trump administration. That's delaying projects to protect communities from wildfires and hurricanes.
contentText:
States say disaster funding from the Federal Emergency Management Agency has slowed to a trickle under the Trump administration. That's delaying projects to protect communities from wildfires and hurricanes.

(Image credit: JOSH EDELSON/AFP via Getty Images)
